edges.reason: Constructor gem_ parameter initializes immutable gem.
Constructor end_ parameter initializes end state variable.
Constructor proxy_ parameter initializes proxy state variable.
Constructor min_ parameter initializes min threshold.
usr parameter indexes wards in rely/deny, altering authorization.
data parameter is written into min after the WAD check.
data address parameter is written into end when what==end.
Deposit wad is added to the caller's per-address sum.
Deposit wad is added to the global Sum threshold tracking.
Deposit wad is passed as the amount to gem.transferFrom.
x feeds the raw z = x + y addition.
y feeds the raw z = x + y addition.
x is an operand of the unchecked-style addition in add.
y is an operand of the unchecked-style addition in add.
add() result flows into the caller's sum entry in join.
add() result flows into the global Sum in join.
Caller-supplied target is used directly as the DenyLike call target.
msg.sender determines which sum entry is credited in join.
msg.sender indexes wards in the auth modifier and rely/deny.
msg.sender is the authorization subject checked by the auth modifier.
msg.sender is the from address of gem.transferFrom in join.
gem contract receives the burn call in burn().
gem contract receives the transferFrom call in join.
end.vat() address is used as the DenyLike target in fire.
end module receives the cage() call in fire.
Sum >= min gate is required before fire executes.
min threshold is compared against Sum in fire.
live flag gates fire execution.
live flag gates join execution.
live flag gates denyProxy execution.
Sum >= min gate is required before denyProxy executes.
min threshold is compared against Sum in denyProxy.
gem token is called with transferFrom during join.
end.live() is queried for the shutdown state check in join.
gem balanceOf/burn calls are made during burn.
proxy != address(0) determines revokesGovernanceAccess return value.
auth modifier gates rely.
auth modifier gates deny.
auth modifier gates file(bytes32,uint256).
auth modifier gates file(bytes32,address).
auth modifier gates cage.
fire conditionally executes the external DenyLike(end.vat()).deny call.
fire executes the external end.cage() call.
vat deny precedes the subsequent end.cage() shutdown call.
denyProxy executes the external DenyLike(target).deny(proxy) call.
join executes the external gem.transferFrom after state updates.
burn executes the external gem.burn call.
Malicious gem token could re-enter join during transferFrom.
Malicious gem token could re-enter burn during burn.
end.cage() could re-enter fire before live is altered.
vat deny call could re-enter fire.
Arbitrary target deny call could re-enter denyProxy.

normalization_plan.reason: usr is only an argument feeding the auth-guarded ward grant and is absorbed by rely's authorization flow.
what_min is the selector argument of file(bytes32,uint256) and carries no independent semantics.
data_min is the value argument of file(bytes32,uint256) that writes min.
what_end is the selector argument of file(bytes32,address) and carries no independent semantics.
data_end is the address argument of file(bytes32,address) that writes end.
target flows directly into the external DenyLike(target).deny call and is captured by that unsafe operation.
wad is solely the deposit amount processed by join's accounting and transfer.
x is an operand consumed entirely by the internal add routine.
y is an operand consumed entirely by the internal add routine.
gem_ is only used during construction to set the immutable gem reference.
end_ is only used during construction to set the end reference.
proxy_ is only used during construction to set the proxy reference.
min_ is only used during construction to set the activation threshold.
ret is the local return value produced exclusively by revokesGovernanceAccess.
z is the local result of the addition performed inside add.
